newsitem.title: FRANCE: GEC Alsthom consortium wins Brazil train contract.
newsitem.headline: GEC Alsthom consortium wins Brazil train contract.

text.p: A consortium led by Anglo-French joint venture GEC Alsthom has won a $205 million contract to supply 30 trains to the Brazilian Sao Paulo suburb, GEC Alsthom said on Wednesday.

The consortium, comprising GEC Alsthom, Adtranz and Spain's CAF, will supply 30 suburban four-car trainsets to the Compania Paulista de Transporte Metropolitano (CPTM) Sao Paulo transport authority, GEC Alsthom said in a statement.

The steel trainsets, with power cars at each end, will carry 1,000 passengers at 120 km per hour. Manufacture and assembly will be divided equally between GEC Alsthom Transporte's Barcelona factory, CAF, and local Brazilian companies. Adtranz will supply the 2,400 kW electrical equipment.
Financing was finalised in Madrid by the Treasury of Barzil and French bank Societe Generale.
